dispositions.topic_text: Required behavior for callers racing with lock-file creation and initialization
dispositions.what: delivery_store note: creating the lock file on first use under concurrent callers (exclusive creation, then open of the existing entry) without a spurious refusal.

dispositions.topic_text: Lock-file identity verification and handling replacement during open and lock acquisition
dispositions.reason: Only the service writes below the state folder and the lock file is never changed or removed (A6 rules 2 and 4); no text admits an actor replacing it.
